jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de Telecomunicaciones/Redes (IP, F5, Cisco, Lan, Wan...
jobs_results.description:
Estamos buscando un/a Ingeniero de Telecomunicaciones/Redes (IP, F5, Cisco, Lan, Wan, VPN, BGP...), para un importante cliente en Madrid, trabajo 100% remoto, puesto estable de larga duración.

Al menos 5 años de experiencia demostrable.

La compañía gestiona una red WAN multi-proveedor internacional amplia. Es necesario:
• Experiencia en el diseño de soluciones WAN redundadas con máxima disponibilidad.
• Diseño y gestión de calidades de servicio y traffic shapping.
• Uso de BGP y OSPF para la solución.
• Gestión cambios con operadores de datos.

Experiencia en despliegue y seguimiento de soluciones de balanceo de tráfico en entornos grandes. Se valorará especialmente F5.

Conocimiento en las siguientes áreas y herramientas:
• Routing, switching y calidad de servicio multifabricante.
• Configuración alta disponibilidad y redundancia (HSRP, VRRP, STP).
• Protocolos TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP 4, etc.

Experiencia en la administración de comunicaciones y seguridad:
• Experiencia demostrable en la... participación de proyectos de diseño e implantación de comunicaciones (Datos WAN, MAN y LAN, datos móvil, servicios TI, Voz sobre IP, servicios de imagen y transporte de video, etc.), en grandes entornos.
• Experiencia en elaboración de planes de pruebas y los correspondientes escenarios de maqueta y preproducción necesarios.
• Experiencia demostrable en anállisis y diseño de topologías de red en entorno empresarial.
• Gestión técnica de seguridad de aplicaciones (Cisco, Paloalto).
• Seguridad perimetral.
• IPS, IDS, correlación.
• Proxy, navegación HTTP y HTTPS.
• Monitorización snmp, Cacti, shell scripting.
• Administración de herramientas de red: DHCP, DNS, WINS.
• Soluciones de aceleración de contenidos.
• Herramientas ofimáticas: MS Office, MS Project.

Valorable:
• Conocimientos en ITIL y estándar de seguridad ISO 27001.
• Certificaciones Cisco: CCNP, CCNA, CCVP, CCSP.
• Servicio 8x5. (Hay guardias, una al mes, aproximadamente, e intervenciones fuera de horario, que se pagan aparte del salario)
• Horario: De L a J 9:00 a 18:00 horas, viernes, de 8 a 15:00h, en días laborables según calendario laboral vigente para las oficinas del cliente, en Pozuelo de Alarcón (Madrid). Actualmente, se trabaja en modalidad de teletrabajo.

Ofrecemos:

Salario: Entre 45.000 € y 55.000 € brutos anuales

Contrato indefinido con nosotros

jobs_results.title: Network Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Arsys is one of the 19 direct participants that Europe has selected to bring to life the IPCEI-CIS, which stands for Important Project of Common European Interest in Cloud Infrastructure Services. This R&D initiative is key to the digital transformation and competitiveness of all European Union member countries.

👀 We are looking for a new team member to join a highly motivated team of networking experts. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the planning, operation, and continuous development of our global hosting networks at IONOS and Arsys data center networks.

You can expect modern, globally distributed, and highly scalable infrastructures. In a culture that highly values creative ideas, agile work methodologies, initiative, and participation, you will take on the following exciting tasks:
• Administration and troubleshooting of highly available and complex network infrastructures, including participation in an on-call service.
• Creation and implementation of... modern network designs.
• Assessment and evaluation of new technologies and products.
• Testing and evaluation of new features, as well as planning and implementation of international configurations.
• Support business goals through efficient operational architecture, active lifecycle management, and agile processes in an agile NetOPS environment.
• Conception, configuration, and development of solutions for network automation.

🏆 We value:
• Computer science degree or equivalent education.
• Minimum of two years of work experience in networking.
• Knowledge of common routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and overlay technologies like VXLAN.
• Experience with traditional network vendors like Cisco and Juniper, as well as network function implementation in Linux systems.
• Passion and enthusiasm for new technologies like network disaggregation with whitebox switches, SONiC, and Cumulus.
• Preference for automation with Ansible, Puppet, and Python instead of manual repetition.
• Like us, you are a fan of open source, especially Linux.
• Ability to communicate fluently with an international team in English and Spanish.

✨We offer you:
• Fixed salary and flexible benefits such as health insurance, daycare allowance, and meal vouchers.
• Flexible working hours to organize your schedule according to your needs.
• Ability to work remotely or in any of our offices located in Logroño, Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Valencia, or Bilbao.
• Invitation to our Arsys events, held twice a year, where we team build and throw a great party for our employees.
• Personalized training in cutting-edge technologies, certifications, or any area that interests you.
• We have a motivated, innovative team that is continuously learning. A culture where your opinion and initiative matter. We want to hear your ideas and see you put them into practice.

Would you like to join our exciting project? Apply

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero C++ con Linux
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres trabajar en un sector que ha sido históricamente uno de los sectores con más crecimiento y más innovadores del mundo? Si tu respuesta es sí y quieres ser un Ingeniero de redes con experiencia C/C++, con conocimiento sobre sistmas operativos Linux, sigue leyendo que te va a interesar.

Pertenecerás a un Grupo que te respaldará en todo momento. Nos dedicamos a proporcionar soluciones innovadoras y tecnológicas. Actualmente, estamos queriendo incorporar a un Ingeniero C++ con Linux para dar servicio a uno de nuestros clientes en Donostia de forma presencial.

Trabajarás en un entorno colaborativo y dinámico, contribuyendo al desarrollo de software crítico para aplicaciones ferroviarias.

Contarás desde un principio con la estabilidad que te mereces, además de poder contar con oportunidades de formación gracias a nuestra propia plataforma de formación para que puedas ir completando tus conocimientos con lo nuevo que vaya saliendo.

Serás el responsable de las siguientes tareas:
•... Diseñar, desarrollar, probar e implementar software entornos C++ en Linux.
• Diseño de soluciones de red que se ajusten a los requisitos específicos de cada proyecto.
• Evaluación de software que realiza funciones de comunicación en redes (DNS, DHCP, SNMP), para interacciones internas y entre trenes y tierra.
• Creación de guiones (scripts) para automatizar procesos y pruebas de software.
• Realización de análisis, diagnóstico y solución de problemas en la red.
• Elaboración e implementación de las configuraciones necesarias en los equipos de la red ferroviaria requeridas para cada proyecto

Para ello, sería interesante que tuvieras 2 o 3 años de experiencia en programar en C++ en entornos de Software Libre, ya que el equipo trabaja de esa manera. No solo eso, sino que sería interesante contar con conocimientos de comunicación de redes, puesto que los desarrollos se llevarán a cabo para sistemas embarcados.

¿Qué necesitas para triunfar en esta posición?
• Conocimientos de programación (C/C++)
• Conocimiento de sistemas operativos Linux (a nivel de servicios, programación de tareas, etc.)
• Scripting (bash, python, etc)
• Buen nivel de Inglés (mínimo B2)
• Conocimientos de redes (subredes, VLAN, etc) y servicios de red (DHCP, DNS, FTP, webservices, etc)
• Herramientas para la identificación de problemas de red (wireshark, tcpdump, ping, traceroute, arp, nslookup, etc)
• Consultas BBDD

jobs_results.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Summary

Werfen is a family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. With the headquarter in Barcelona, it operates directly in 30 countries, more than 100 territories through distributors, and with a workforce of 7000 employees. Werfen is a specialized diagnostics company committed to providing innovative solutions to hostipals and laboratories, powering patient care around the world.

With a strong passion for designing and implementing robust, secure, and scalable network solutions, the Senior Network Engineer with join a fast-paced, collaborative environment and will contribute in driving innovation and excellence in our network infrastructure to support our organization's growth and success.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our enterprise network infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of our network... environment, enabling seamless communication and connectivity for our organization.

Key Accountabilities

• Network Design and Architecture:

o Design and implement network architectures, including LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless networks, to meet the evolving needs of the organization.

o Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to recommend network design enhancements and optimization opportunities.

• Network Implementation and Configuration:

o Configure and deploy network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless access points, following best practices and security standards.

o Collaborate with system administrators and other IT teams to integrate network solutions with existing infrastructure and applications.

• Network Security:

o Implement and maintain network security measures, including access controls, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and VPN technologies, to safeguard against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

o Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify and address potential security risks and compliance issues.

• Network Monitoring and Performance Optimization:

o Monitor network performance, availability, and reliability using network monitoring tools and utilities.

o Troubleshoot network issues, analyze performance data, and implement optimization measures to enhance network performance and efficiency.

• Incident Response and Problem Management:

o Lead the resolution of network-related incidents and service disruptions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to minimize downtime and impact on business operations.

o Conduct root cause analysis for network issues and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

• Documentation and Standards Compliance:

o Create and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and technical specifications.

o Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies related to network infrastructure and security.

• Capacity Planning and Scalability:

o Perform capacity planning for network resources and bandwidth requirements based on business growth projections and usage patterns.

o Recommend and implement scalable solutions to accommodate the organization's expanding network infrastructure needs.

Networking/Key relationships

• Colleagues in the Infrastructure and Support organization

• IT Leadership Team

• Enterprise Architect

• Information Security

• PMO

• Enterprise Application & Development

• Business stakeholders

• Technology Partners / Service Providers

Minimum Knowledge & Experience required for the position:

• Master degree in Computer Science, or related field.

• Proven experience as a network engineer or in a similar role, designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-level network infrastructure.

• Hands-on experience with network equipment and technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, Aruba, and Fortinet.

• Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, CISSP, or relevant vendor certifications are highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and take decisions in alignment with management.

• People-, customer- and service-oriented mindset.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and oral), at ease interacting with management.

Skills & Capabilities:

• In-depth knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP), and network security principles.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues and implement effective solutions.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Travel requirements: Occasional travel required to main Werfen locations or based on project requirements

With a strong passion for designing and implementing robust, secure, and scalable network solutions, the Senior Network Engineer with join a fast-paced, collaborative environment and will contribute in driving innovation and excellence in our network infrastructure to support our organization's growth and success.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our enterprise network infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of our network... environment, enabling seamless communication and connectivity for our organization.

Key Accountabilities

• Network Design and Architecture:

o Design and implement network architectures, including LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless networks, to meet the evolving needs of the organization.

o Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to recommend network design enhancements and optimization opportunities.

• Network Implementation and Configuration:

o Configure and deploy network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless access points, following best practices and security standards.

o Collaborate with system administrators and other IT teams to integrate network solutions with existing infrastructure and applications.

• Network Security:

o Implement and maintain network security measures, including access controls, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and VPN technologies, to safeguard against cyber threats and vulnerabilities.

o Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify and address potential security risks and compliance issues.

• Network Monitoring and Performance Optimization:

o Monitor network performance, availability, and reliability using network monitoring tools and utilities.

o Troubleshoot network issues, analyze performance data, and implement optimization measures to enhance network performance and efficiency.

• Incident Response and Problem Management:

o Lead the resolution of network-related incidents and service disruptions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to minimize downtime and impact on business operations.

o Conduct root cause analysis for network issues and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

• Documentation and Standards Compliance:

o Create and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and technical specifications.

o Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies related to network infrastructure and security.

• Capacity Planning and Scalability:

o Perform capacity planning for network resources and bandwidth requirements based on business growth projections and usage patterns.

o Recommend and implement scalable solutions to accommodate the organization's expanding network infrastructure needs.

Networking/Key relationships

• Colleagues in the Infrastructure and Support organization

• IT Leadership Team

• Enterprise Architect

• Information Security

• PMO

• Enterprise Application & Development

• Business stakeholders

• Technology Partners / Service Providers

Minimum Knowledge & Experience required for the position:

• Master degree in Computer Science, or related field.

• Proven experience as a network engineer or in a similar role, designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-level network infrastructure.

• Hands-on experience with network equipment and technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, Aruba, and Fortinet.

• Certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, CISSP, or relevant vendor certifications are highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and take decisions in alignment with management.

• People-, customer- and service-oriented mindset.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and oral), at ease interacting with management.

Skills & Capabilities:

• In-depth knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP), and network security principles.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues and implement effective solutions.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Travel requirements: Occasional travel required to main Werfen locations or based on project requirements

jobs_results.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

PSI is an award-winning full-service CRO, bringing together more than 2,700 dynamic and knowledgeable individuals working to help impact the future of medicine in more than 60 countries around the world. We support pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies with the services needed to perform clinical trials of new medicines. Our work helps patients in need improve their well-being – a fundamental driver for many of us to show up and do our best each day.

Job Description

Fixed Term Contract / Full-time / Remote. Contract length 6-8 months.

You will join an exciting and challenging project to assess the state of PSI internal network infrastructure, share your expertise with our internal IT teams, setup processes and procedures that are required to manage the network successfully, and implement IT infrastructure systems to support PSI business processes and operations. You will work as a part of an international IT team, mentoring engineers to... troubleshoot and optimize PSI networks for our users.

You will:
• Plan, design and implement LAN/WAN/Security solutions that are in line with industry standards and compliance.
• Review, assess, and recommend network standards to support, routing & switching, data centers, cloud-based architectures.
• Evaluate the current state of the network, provide recommendations and implement solution to ensure the network architecture are updated with latest industry best practices.
• Produce High Level Design and Low Level Design documentation for network projects.
• Develop and implement network related processes and procedures, troubleshoot reported errors.
• Optimize and maintain LAN and WAN.
• Optimize and maintain backup and restore processes.
• Translate highly technical specifications into clear non-technical requirements.
• Create IT guidelines and manuals; maintain complete technical documentation.
• Work as coach and mentor for team members, with an intuition for analyzing and solving technical problems.
• Peer review network configuration changes and provide training to empower engineers and operational staff on performing network infrastructure support and maintenance.

Qualifications
• Demonstrated experience as a senior network engineer, network design engineer or architect
• Professional certification (e.g. CCNP, CCSP, CCDP)
• Experience with network diagnostic, logging, monitoring and analysis tools
• In-depth understanding of communication protocols (mainly TCP/IP) and routing protocols (e.g. BGP, OSPF)
• Cloud solution experience is desirable
• Ability to assess business needs and translate them into relevant solutions
• Ability to document and maintain detailed technical documentation and procedures
• Ability to quickly learn new, unfamiliar and emerging technologies
• Organizational and mentoring skills
• Ability to precisely explain complex issues
• University Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or the like
• Full working proficiency in English

Additional Information

You will work closely with driven and dedicated cross-functional teams, get all support and ownership of your projects. If you feel it is time to make your skills and knowledge visible within a growing company with true focus on its people, then PSI is the right choice for you
